evidence: the-interface-stanza-says-static-at-boot: :13 network_route 'default' (network default, netmask 0.0.0.0, gateway $gateway, interface eth0) renders as the routes line 'default 0.0.0.0 192.0.2.1 eth0' under the fixture gateway 192.0.2.1 (seen verbatim in /etc/network/routes on the applied node); with :11-12 (ifupdown-extra installed; onboot true/hotplug false -> auto, inet static, ipaddress 192.0.2.10) the probe and expect test exactly what the lines declare

ifupdown-and-the-networking-service: :12 onboot => 'true' declares a stanza read at boot; on Ubuntu 24.04 only ifupdown's enabled networking service reads it, which is what local change #11 (ensure_packages ifupdown, row 11) adds; probe checks ifupdown installed + networking enabled, consistent with the lines plus the recorded local change

the-boot-step-brings-the-interface-up: :12 onboot true, method static, ipaddress $ipaddress -> starting networking.service (what a boot runs) must give p8test0 192.0.2.10 (/24 is ifupdown's default with no netmask, as measured) and reach the LAN; the a-lan-on-the-interface setup (namespace + veth p8test0, gateway 192.0.2.1/24) only supplies the interface and a peer, declares all it creates, and changes nothing the class declares; effects are read-only ip/ping results, not the actions' output

finding the-default-route-goes-through-the-gateway: expected 1 default route via 192.0.2.1, saw 0 (stdout '0'); the node's only default route is via 10.0.2.2 dev enp0s3.
